selection.method: Live GitHub code search for source implementations of Google ADK, Pydantic AI, and OpenAI Agents. Candidates were source-screened for meaningful agent/tool/MCP authority composition, checked against HorusTrace committed research for prior use, and frozen by exact repository SHA before the first HorusTrace execution.

cases.selection_signal: ADK LlmAgent combining stdio MCP with local workspace mutation and Souffle subprocess execution tools.
ADK multi-agent orchestrator delegating task/calendar operations and real software deploy/rollback/provision actions.
ADK commerce agent with checkout and purchase tools; complete_purchase is explicitly wrapped with require_confirmation=True.
ADK incident responder mixing direct GitLab API reads with an authenticated GitLab stdio MCP toolset instructed to create issues and MR comments.
Pydantic AI coding agent with cwd-confined file read/write/search and model-controlled shell execution.
Pydantic AI factory whose decorated run_python tool delegates arbitrary Python execution to a repository-local helper.
Pydantic AI WhatsApp agent with outbound messaging, dynamic command execution, feature mutation, allowed/blocked action policy and permission checks.
Pydantic AI trading agent with web/account reads and create_order/close_position mutations guarded by runtime allow_trading.
OpenAI Agents autonomous worker exposing a model-controlled shell=True subprocess tool scoped to a workspace.
OpenAI Agents coding workflow with workspace-confined reads/writes, shell execution, checkpoint and push operations.
OpenAI Agents async factory that creates/connects an authenticated DingTalk MCPServerStdio then binds it through mcp_servers.
OpenAI Agents factory binding cross-file GitHub function tools for repository metadata/content/statistics and file listing through an authenticated client.
